description: What prompt caching and batch / flex save on one model: monthly input and output tokens priced at every listed seller plain, with the given share of input read from the cache (the seller's own cache-read price) and, if can_wait, the seller's batch / flex offers. USD, cheapest first; cache write fees are not counted. Each row has card_url and cite.

cache_pct.description: percent of input tokens read from the prompt cache, default 50

can_wait.description: include batch / flex offers (results later, not real-time)

name: cache_batch_savings
